name: Illustrative: camt.053 reconciliation-ready
counterparty: ILLUSTRATIVE example, not any bank's rules

rules.why: each statement needs its own identifier to be matched once
the sequence number shows a statement was missed
entries are matched to a ledger account by IBAN
the account currency anchors every entry's amount
opening and closing booked balances prove the statement adds up
an entry reference lets an exception be quoted back to the bank
only booked entries are reconciled; pending ones arrive in camt.054
the booking date drives the matching window
the end-to-end id is the usual key back to an invoice
